status: written before any pcu arm ran and before any v2 summary was computed; after independent review 1 (artifacts/agent_orchestration/handoffs/Q4-activation-attribution-review.md, findings B1-B3 and the must-fix items)
observation_motivating_it: Review finding B1: tools/experiment_b2_attrib/pcfull.py keeps every k-th value in (image, row, column) order with k = ceil(256*H*W/4096) = H*W/16, so on 112x112 maps (k = 784 = 7*112) all 4096 search values of a channel come from image column 0, on 56x56 maps from columns {0, 28}, on 28x28 maps from four columns. The pcf per-channel scales were therefore fitted on border pixels, not on 'the full FP32 activations' as addendum 2 and the doc state. The reviewer's rerun with a stride coprime to H and W changed several pcf results by up to 25 pp (MobileNetV2 INT8 pcf:all 47.05 -> 72.38). Every claim resting on pcf is re-measured here.

pcu_definition.term: pcu:TARGET = pcf:TARGET (addendum 2: same eligibility, folding into conv/linear consumers, other consumers per-channel requantized, bias-correction refit, pcu wins over affine on overlap) with a different sample of MSE-search values
pcu_definition.sample: per node, a simple random sample without replacement of min(n, 4096) positions (image, row, column) out of the n = 256*H*W positions of the FP32 node output on the 256 bias-correction calibration images (first 256 of the frozen calibration list); the same positions for every channel of the node; torch.randperm(n, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261002 + zlib.crc32(node name)))[:4096], sorted. Every position has the same inclusion probability.
pcu_definition.anchor: exact per-channel max |x| over all 256 images and positions (unchanged from pcf)
pcu_definition.search: frozen tools/experiment_b2/scales.py mse_search with the boundary's own B2 table (unchanged)
pcu_definition.tests: tests/unit/test_experiment_b2_attrib_pcu.py (6 pass on CPU before any measurement: seeded sample, full row/column coverage on 112/56/28 maps where the pcf stride hits <= 4 columns, exact kept positions across chunks, parse)
pcu_definition.records: artifacts/experiment_b2_attrib/arms/<model>--<format>/pcu~*.json; the 36 pcf records stay unchanged and are reported as 'pcf (border-column sample; superseded by pcu)'
pcu_definition.per_node_evidence: each pcu record stores per boundary: positions kept, sha256 of the positions, distinct rows/columns/images touched, min and median ratio of the found scale to the max-abs scale (the 2^-6 search floor = 0.015625 flags clipping)

mobilenet_v3_large.combination: affine:signed + the best of pcu:role.dw_conv, pcu:role.se_product, pcu:kind.hardswish, pcu:all on that format (highest top-1 expected on the screen, ties by lower mean KL): the addendum-2 rule re-applied to pcu, selected inside the same job after the four arms exist (pcurunner --combo). Includes FP8 E4M3, which addendum 2 planned and the GPU cap dropped.

regression.combination: affine:signed+pcu:all on MobileNetV2 and ResNet18 INT8 when pcu:all is the best of the four MobileNetV3 INT8 pcu arms (addendum-2 regression rule; pcurunner --regression-combo-from mobilenet_v3_large/int8); otherwise skipped and reported

arms.total: 28 MobileNetV3 arms + 4 MobileNetV3 combinations + 4 regression arms + up to 2 regression combinations + 1 addendum-7 arm

reading_rules.evidence: development: ImageNet 1k screen, top-1 expected credit, paired bootstrap of tools/analysis/b2_matrix.interval
reading_rules.selection: r3 arms and combinations were chosen on the screen; any gain is optimistic and needs held-out confirmation (owner's decision)
reading_rules.sampler_sensitivity: the reviewer's coprime-stride reruns (review-scratch/out-*.json, 7 arms) are a second unbiased sampler: the doc reports pcu next to them as a sensitivity check; no new GPU job for it

cpu.fold_diagnostic_v2: the addendum-6 fold diagnostic (tools/experiment_b2_attrib/folddiag.py) rerun with pcu scales through a wrapper (tools/experiment_b2_attrib/folddiag_pcu.py), MobileNetV2/MobileNetV3/ResNet18 INT8, written once to artifacts/experiment_b2_attrib/folddiag/fold-diagnostic-v2-pcu.json; v1 stays
cpu.summaries_v2: results/summaries/b2-attrib-v1/v2/ (written once; v1 stays): (a) review B3 fix: leave-one-out takes only records named wide:node.<node> without a '+' suffix (the addendum-5 '+fixbc' arm is excluded); (b) B tables with pcu arms, pcf labelled superseded; (c) predictor statistics: Spearman rho with a percentile bootstrap 95 % interval over groups (10000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261002)), per cell and pooled; within-cell mean rho with a stratified permutation p (y permuted within each cell, 10000 permutations, same seed); Holm adjustment over every SQNR-predictor p-value reported in the doc; (d) stem damage/recovery with intervals in every attributed cell, so that 'largest' is read with its interval

gpu.path: low-memory path of addendum 1 through tools/run/experiment_b2_attrib_pcu_queue.sh (--min-free-mib 3000, OOM retried once with --heavy 8000)
gpu.jobs: 7 jobs, one per (model, format): queue A = MobileNetV3 INT8 (+combo), MobileNetV2 INT8, ResNet18 INT8, MobileNetV2 FP6 E2M3 (addendum 7); queue B = MobileNetV3 INT6, FP6 E2M3, FP8 E4M3 (+combo each); at most 2 Q4 jobs at a time, each < 15 min (--max-seconds 840)
gpu.cap: 3600 s of recorded job wall for addendum-8 jobs (ledger artifacts/experiment_b2_attrib/pcu/logs/jobs.jsonl), checked before each job with that job's estimate (stage-start rule); a job that would pass the cap is skipped and reported. Priority by queue order: INT8 and regression first, FP8 last.
gpu.deviation: the lane had used 10481 s (9281 s recorded + 1200 s allowance) of the original 10800 s cap; this re-measurement is required by the review and takes the lane total to at most 14081 s (3.9 GPU-hours) against the brief's 'about 3 GPU-hours'. Reported as a deviation for the owner.
